reference: median ground of the whole Sentinel-1 frame 7091 (descending, track 27); not a hand-picked site

nisar.scope: Average over the whole study box (not only the sinking area), from consecutive pairs; very noisy.
nisar.status_note: Provisional NISAR data; short record; rate not yet reliable.

caveats: Referenced to the median ground of the whole satellite frame; a few mm/yr of bias is possible.
Troposphere (water vapour) is not corrected; solid-earth tide and ionosphere are.
Uncertainty shown is the fit error of a straight line only; it ignores reference bias and is optimistic.
Sinking does not by itself show who or what caused it.
source: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1 block-final granules, 6-month steps
